column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 16 (M23016): Komandan terluka & dievakuasi; Lentine sadar Kenny tewas.
# Tetap Inggris: Vindicator's Mark, Graurizard, Boojum, Vasily, Klukai, Zhaohui, Cheyanne,
# Wulfgar, Lentine, Kenny, Basti, Faelynn, Mokosh, Squad 404, Monsoon Squad, Oathguards,
# Doll, Frame, Red Zone.
(After being hit by the powerful energy beam of the "Vindicator's Mark", the giant dragon let out a mournful roar in the sky and plummeted downwards as if out of control.)
column2: (Setelah dihantam sinar energi dahsyat "Vindicator's Mark", naga raksasa itu meraung pilu di langit dan terjun ke bawah seolah lepas kendali.)

column1: (Coordinating with the fire support from the command center, the Dolls threw all their weapons into the engagement. The bombardment of gunfire was continuous, shooting the giant dragon's head and neck area full of holes.)
column2: (Berkoordinasi dengan dukungan tembakan dari pusat komando, para Doll mengerahkan seluruh senjatanya ke pertempuran. Gempuran tembakan tak henti-henti, melubangi kepala dan leher naga raksasa itu.)

column1: (Finally, as if unable to bear the trauma to its body any longer, Graurizard roared and broke free from the Dolls' suppression, flapping its tattered wings to flee the ruins.)
column2: (Akhirnya, seolah tak sanggup lagi menanggung luka di tubuhnya, Graurizard mengaum dan melepaskan diri dari tekanan para Doll, mengepakkan sayapnya yang compang-camping untuk kabur dari reruntuhan.)

column1: (The giant dragon flapped its wings, bringing up a fierce wind, and went far away along with the impact brought by the roar.)
column2: (Naga raksasa itu mengepakkan sayap, menimbulkan angin ganas, lalu menjauh bersama hantaman yang dibawa raungannya.)

column1: Cough, cough cough... Commander...
column2: Uhuk, uhuk uhuk... Komandan...

column1: The Commander!
column2: Komandan!

column1: (As soon as Vasily, who had just been dug out of the rubble, opened his eyes, he anxiously knelt before the temporary camp bed. The Commander was lying there with his eyes tightly closed. His forehead and body were tightly bound with bandages, and blood was still constantly seeping out from under the bandages.)
column2: (Begitu membuka mata setelah baru saja digali dari reruntuhan, Vasily langsung berlutut cemas di depan ranjang darurat. Komandan terbaring di sana dengan mata terpejam rapat. Dahi dan tubuhnya terbalut perban erat, dan darah masih terus merembes dari balik perban itu.)

column1: Where's the doctor! Why hasn't the doctor come yet?
column2: Mana dokternya! Kenapa dokternya belum datang juga?

column1: The doctor is already on the way. I've done a preliminary check; the coma might be caused by... a combination of the explosion's impact and blood loss.
column2: Dokternya sudah dalam perjalanan. Saya sudah memeriksa awal; komanya mungkin disebabkan... gabungan hantaman ledakan dan kehilangan darah.

column1: I need to tell the doctor to perform emergency surgery right away...
column2: Aku harus menyuruh dokter melakukan operasi darurat sekarang juga...

column1: A-And also...
column2: D-Dan juga...

column1: Mr. Vasily... please calm down.
column2: Pak Vasily... tolong tenang.

column1: My team has already administered emergency treatment to the Commander. We will arrange everything else properly.
column2: Tim saya sudah memberikan penanganan darurat pada Komandan. Sisanya akan kami atur dengan baik.

column1: What I want to discuss with you is another matter.
column2: Yang ingin saya bicarakan dengan Anda adalah hal lain.

column1: Okay... please go ahead and say it.
column2: Baik... silakan katakan.

column1: Mr. Vasily, if you trust us, you can leave the matter of commanding the combat to Squad 404 later.
column2: Pak Vasily, kalau Anda memercayai kami, urusan memimpin pertempuran nanti bisa diserahkan pada Squad 404.

column1: But we need you to send some more personnel to guard the Commander's safety.
column2: Tapi kami butuh Anda mengirim beberapa personel lagi untuk menjaga keselamatan Komandan.

column1: Yes, as long as the Commander's safety can be ensured, the Monsoon Squad can execute combat missions independently.
column2: Ya, selama keselamatan Komandan terjamin, Monsoon Squad bisa menjalankan misi tempur secara mandiri.

column1: (Vasily pondered for a moment, then firmly shook his head.)
column2: (Vasily termenung sejenak, lalu menggeleng mantap.)

column1: The personnel who can ensure the Commander's safety right now are not the Mokosh Defense Forces, but you.
column2: Yang bisa menjamin keselamatan Komandan sekarang bukan Pasukan Pertahanan Mokosh, melainkan kalian.

column1: ...What do you mean?
column2: ...Apa maksud Anda?

column1: (As if having made up his mind, Vasily looked around at the Dolls surrounding the Commander.)
column2: (Seolah sudah membulatkan tekad, Vasily menyapu pandangan ke para Doll yang mengelilingi Komandan.)

column1: To Mokosh, the Commander is an absolutely indispensable ally. Ensuring his safety is the most important thing right now.
column2: Bagi Mokosh, Komandan adalah sekutu yang mutlak tak tergantikan. Menjamin keselamatannya adalah hal terpenting saat ini.

column1: I hope you can take him and evacuate from Mokosh to a safe place for comprehensive treatment.
column2: Saya harap kalian bisa membawanya keluar dari Mokosh ke tempat aman untuk mendapat perawatan menyeluruh.

column1: (Vasily suppresses the anxiety in his heart. Under these circumstances, every bit of combat strength seems especially important. But facing the Dolls' proposal, he knows well that a choice must be made.)
column2: (Vasily menekan kegelisahan di hatinya. Dalam keadaan seperti ini, setiap serpih kekuatan tempur terasa sangat penting. Tapi menghadapi usul para Doll, dia sadar betul sebuah pilihan harus diambil.)

column1: Please protect the Commander well for me.
column2: Tolong lindungi Komandan baik-baik untukku.

column1: Mokosh will definitely face even fiercer attacks. I am the leader of Mokosh, and I will definitely fight to the last moment.
column2: Mokosh pasti akan menghadapi serangan yang lebih ganas. Saya pemimpin Mokosh, dan saya pasti akan bertempur sampai detik terakhir.

column1: The Commander... is my hope. If I truly meet my end with death, I hope the Commander can help Mokosh keep going.
column2: Komandan... adalah harapan saya. Kalau saya benar-benar menemui ajal, saya harap Komandan bisa membantu Mokosh terus bertahan.

column1: With all due respect, protecting Mokosh is the Commander's wish, and also the reason we have fought until now.
column2: Dengan segala hormat, melindungi Mokosh adalah keinginan Komandan, sekaligus alasan kami bertempur sampai sekarang.

column1: If we retreat with the Commander at a time like this, it would be going against his will.
column2: Kalau kami mundur membawa Komandan di saat seperti ini, itu justru melawan kehendaknya.

column1: (Vasily let out a long sigh, and after a long time, seemed to have figured something out.)
column2: (Vasily menghela napas panjang, dan setelah sekian lama, seolah menemukan jawabannya.)

column1: You're right, for him and for the people of Mokosh, I... shouldn't easily give up my life.
column2: Kau benar, demi dia dan demi warga Mokosh, saya... tidak seharusnya gampang menyerahkan nyawa.

column1: A war of attrition, we can fight it, and we can afford it. However, I still insist on my decision to have you send the Commander away, because only with him here is there hope for victory in this battle.
column2: Perang gesekan, kami sanggup menjalaninya, dan kami sanggup menanggungnya. Tapi saya tetap bersikeras pada keputusan meminta kalian membawa Komandan pergi, karena hanya dengan dia ada, pertempuran ini punya harapan menang.

column1: (Watching Klukai nod with difficulty, Vasily took out his communication terminal and showed the Dolls the recently cleared underground passage.)
column2: (Melihat Klukai mengangguk dengan berat, Vasily mengeluarkan terminal komunikasinya dan menunjukkan pada para Doll lorong bawah tanah yang baru dibuka.)

column1: Everyone, prioritize ensuring the Commander's safety, and then... utilizing the terrain advantage, we can still use the tunnels to continue dealing with the enemy and seize victory.
column2: Semuanya, prioritaskan keselamatan Komandan, lalu... dengan memanfaatkan keunggulan medan, kita masih bisa memakai terowongan untuk terus menghadapi musuh dan merebut kemenangan.

column1: Monsoon is the squad most familiar with the Mokosh battlefield, having fought alongside the Oathguards since Mokosh's first rebellion.
column2: Monsoon adalah regu yang paling hafal medan tempur Mokosh, sudah bertempur bersama Oathguards sejak pemberontakan pertama Mokosh.

column1: Hand the escort mission over to another squad. Monsoon staying here is the only way to maximize their value.
column2: Serahkan misi pengawalan pada regu lain. Monsoon tetap di sini adalah satu-satunya cara memaksimalkan nilai mereka.

column1: If the Commander were awake, they would definitely make the same judgment.
column2: Kalau Komandan sadar, dia pasti akan mengambil keputusan yang sama.

column1: Yes, I am familiar with Mokosh's terrain and alleys, I will also stay to support.
column2: Ya, saya hafal medan dan gang-gang Mokosh, saya juga akan tinggal untuk membantu.

column1: Team 2 is the same. The central urban area still needs to be garrisoned. We'll stay... at least we won't lose too miserably.
column2: Tim 2 juga sama. Kawasan kota pusat masih perlu dijaga. Kami tinggal... setidaknya kita tidak akan kalah terlalu menyedihkan.

column1: I agree. Squad 404 will prioritize completing the mission of escorting the Commander, and then immediately rush to support. Monsoon, Cheyanne, and Team 2, stay in Mokosh to support.
column2: Aku setuju. Squad 404 memprioritaskan penyelesaian misi mengawal Komandan, lalu langsung bergegas membantu. Monsoon, Cheyanne, dan Tim 2, tetap di Mokosh untuk mendukung.

column1: The Commander has been working hard to command since arriving in Mokosh. I believe that if he were still awake, he would definitely also hope that we fight side by side with Mokosh until the last moment.
column2: Komandan sudah bekerja keras memimpin sejak tiba di Mokosh. Saya yakin kalau dia masih sadar, dia pasti juga berharap kita bertempur berdampingan dengan Mokosh sampai detik terakhir.

column1: (With the statements of Zhaohui and the others, in the room and on the communication, more Dolls stood up, expressing their determination to continue fighting side by side with Mokosh.)
column2: (Setelah pernyataan Zhaohui dan yang lain, di dalam ruangan maupun di kanal komunikasi, makin banyak Doll berdiri, menyatakan tekad untuk terus bertempur berdampingan dengan Mokosh.)

column1: (Hearing the voices of support from all around, Vasily's eyes turned red.)
column2: (Mendengar suara-suara dukungan dari segala penjuru, mata Vasily memerah.)

column1: Good, good...! I understand, thank you, thank you for your determination.
column2: Baik, baik...! Saya mengerti, terima kasih, terima kasih atas tekad kalian.

column1: Mokosh will definitely fight to the end and never let everyone down!
column2: Mokosh pasti akan bertempur sampai akhir dan tidak akan mengecewakan kalian!

column1: Before the escort mission begins, there is one more thing.
column2: Sebelum misi pengawalan dimulai, ada satu hal lagi.

column1: The Commander's body is not suitable for bumping. Before entering the tunnel, I need everyone to try to lure away the nearby enemy troops.
column2: Tubuh Komandan tidak boleh terguncang-guncang. Sebelum masuk ke terowongan, aku butuh kalian berusaha memancing pergi pasukan musuh di sekitar.

column1: Besides Team 2, which is executing the ground guard mission, what other squads can come to help?
column2: Selain Tim 2 yang menjalankan misi jaga di permukaan, regu mana lagi yang bisa membantu?

column1: Let our Monsoon Squad do it.
column2: Biar Monsoon Squad kami yang melakukannya.

column1: The Oathguard troops can also attract some firepower, leave it to me and Wulfgar!
column2: Pasukan Oathguard juga bisa memancing sebagian tembakan, serahkan pada saya dan Wulfgar!

column1: I will observe remotely from the sniping point and clear approaching enemies in advance. Basti and Faelynn haven't finished restarting their Frames yet, let's keep the Commander's injury a secret from them for now.
column2: Saya akan mengamati dari jauh di titik penembakan dan membersihkan musuh yang mendekat lebih awal. Basti dan Faelynn belum selesai memulai ulang Frame mereka, luka Komandan kita rahasiakan dulu dari mereka.

column1: Then, now, the escort begins!
column2: Kalau begitu, sekarang pengawalan dimulai!

column1: (Tens of minutes ago.)
column2: (Beberapa puluh menit sebelumnya.)

column1: (After sending Kenny to the infirmary for emergency rescue, Lentine returned to the bridge.)
column2: (Setelah mengirim Kenny ke ruang perawatan untuk pertolongan darurat, Lentine kembali ke anjungan.)

column1: (Outside the bridge, the wreckage of several Dolls was still messily piled on the deck, but with the tense situation on the front lines, Lentine had no time to deal with them.)
column2: (Di luar anjungan, puing beberapa Doll masih menumpuk berantakan di geladak, tapi dengan situasi garis depan yang menegangkan, Lentine tak sempat mengurusnya.)

column1: Commander Lentine, received a report from the West Line Assault Team. Two powerful Dolls launched an attack, and the squad was completely wiped out!
column2: Komandan Lentine, ada laporan dari Tim Serbu Garis Barat. Dua Doll yang kuat melancarkan serangan, dan regunya musnah total!

column1: Is Squad B ready? Dispatch Squad B to support the west front immediately!
column2: Regu B sudah siap? Kirim Regu B untuk membantu front barat sekarang juga!

column1: Sir, the airstrike drones sent to the southeast have been intercepted, with a destruction rate of 87%!
column2: Bu, drone serangan udara yang dikirim ke tenggara sudah dicegat, tingkat kehancurannya 87%!

column1: Send another drone team to suppress! Coordinate with missiles to increase the coverage of the fire network! We must break through Mokosh's anti-aircraft system as soon as possible!
column2: Kirim satu tim drone lagi untuk menekan! Koordinasikan dengan rudal untuk memperluas jangkauan jaring tembak! Kita harus menembus sistem anti-pesawat Mokosh secepatnya!

column1: Sir, a giant creature has been spotted in the air, suspected to be in the form of a flying dragon, and is, is approaching the enemy—
column2: Bu, terlihat makhluk raksasa di udara, diduga berwujud naga terbang, dan sedang, sedang mendekati musuh—

column1: What?
column2: Apa?

column1: (Before Lentine can question further, she already sees an apocalyptic scene through the porthole—)
column2: (Sebelum Lentine sempat bertanya lebih jauh, dia sudah melihat pemandangan bak kiamat lewat jendela bundar—)

column1: (A giant flying dragon the size of a battleship dives down from the cloudy sky, spewing artillery fire and energy toward the enemy anti-air network that has withstood attacks for so long.)
column2: (Naga terbang raksasa sebesar kapal perang menukik dari langit berawan, menyemburkan tembakan artileri dan energi ke jaring anti-udara musuh yang sekian lama bertahan dari serangan.)

column1: (Lentine stares in disbelief at the legendary creature. She remembers seeing that guy from a distance in the Red Zone once, but after such a short time, the other party has grown to such an astonishing size, and can even launch objects like missiles from its wings?)
column2: (Lentine menatap tak percaya pada makhluk legendaris itu. Dia ingat pernah melihatnya dari kejauhan di Red Zone, tapi dalam waktu sesingkat itu makhluk itu tumbuh sebesar ini, bahkan bisa meluncurkan benda seperti rudal dari sayapnya?)

column1: (Is that really a Boojum? Or some kind of artificial dragon-shaped weapon?)
column2: (Apa itu benar-benar Boojum? Atau semacam senjata buatan berwujud naga?)

column1: (No, what made her even more unbelievable was that the dragon was now attacking in an almost crazy posture.)
column2: (Bukan, yang lebih tak masuk akal baginya adalah naga itu kini menyerang dengan gaya yang nyaris gila.)

column1: (Without distinguishing friend from foe, soldier from civilian, munitions rained down on Mokosh. In mere seconds, Mokosh's long-impregnable anti-aircraft system was crushed by the dragon, and what's more, the dragon was crashing towards the ground alongside the barrage—)
column2: (Tanpa membedakan kawan dan lawan, prajurit dan warga sipil, amunisi menghujani Mokosh. Hanya dalam hitungan detik, sistem anti-pesawat Mokosh yang sekian lama tak tertembus digilas naga itu, dan lebih dari itu, naga itu menghantam ke tanah bersama hujan tembakannya—)

column1: (Bang—)
column2: (Blam—)

column1: (Bang bang—)
column2: (Blam blam—)

column1: (The wilderness shook, the ground collapsed with a crash, and the giant dragon drilled into the torn hole, continuing to pour heavenly fire onto the city hidden underground, equally bringing down judgment and disaster upon everyone.)
column2: (Padang tandus berguncang, tanahnya ambruk dengan gemuruh, dan naga raksasa itu menerobos masuk ke lubang yang tercabik, terus menghujankan api dari langit ke kota yang tersembunyi di bawah tanah, menurunkan penghakiman dan bencana secara merata pada semua orang.)

column1: What the hell is that dragon doing!
column2: Apa yang sedang dilakukan naga sialan itu!

column1: (Lentine stood up abruptly.)
column2: (Lentine berdiri mendadak.)

column1: (Through the reconnaissance drone that followed the giant dragon underground, she saw the terrifying scene in that city, saw the corpses smashed in half by falling dome fragments, and saw the crowd fleeing in panic under the 'heavenly fire'.)
column2: (Lewat drone pengintai yang mengikuti naga raksasa itu ke bawah tanah, dia melihat pemandangan mengerikan di kota tersebut, melihat mayat-mayat yang terbelah dua tertimpa serpihan kubah, dan melihat kerumunan yang lari panik di bawah 'api dari langit'.)

column1: Tch...! Fuck it!
column2: Cih...! Sialan!

column1: I have my deployments, who allowed that dragon to do such superfluous things?!
column2: Aku punya penempatanku sendiri, siapa yang mengizinkan naga itu berbuat hal berlebihan begitu?!

column1: (An unnamed fire rose in her heart as Lentine clenched her fists tightly. Too many unexpected things had happened to her today. Her anger was not only because her plans were disrupted, but also because the sudden appearance of such a massive monster on the battlefield could very well cause the inexperienced ordinary squad members to be frightened and waver, affecting their side's morale.)
column2: (Api tanpa nama berkobar di hatinya saat Lentine mengepalkan tinjunya erat-erat. Terlalu banyak hal tak terduga menimpanya hari ini. Kemarahannya bukan cuma karena rencananya berantakan, tapi juga karena munculnya monster sebesar itu di medan tempur bisa saja membuat anggota regu biasa yang minim pengalaman ketakutan dan goyah, sehingga memengaruhi semangat pihaknya.)

column1: (Such a situation must not be allowed to continue; she had to have her adjutant stop it as soon as possible.)
column2: (Keadaan seperti itu tidak boleh dibiarkan berlanjut; dia harus menyuruh ajudannya menghentikannya secepat mungkin.)

column1: (Almost like a roar, she called out his name.)
column2: (Nyaris seperti raungan, dia memanggil nama ajudannya.)

column1: Kenny, Kenny! Contact all superiors right now and request authorization; we can't let that dragon keep going crazy—
column2: Kenny, Kenny! Hubungi semua atasan sekarang juga dan minta otorisasi; kita tidak boleh membiarkan naga itu terus mengamuk—

column1: (With her calls going unanswered for a long time, Lentine subconsciously turned around.)
column2: (Karena panggilannya lama tak berbalas, Lentine tanpa sadar berbalik.)

column1: (The spot where her adjutant, who always smiled at her, used to stand was now completely empty, devoid of anyone.)
column2: (Tempat ajudannya yang selalu tersenyum padanya biasa berdiri kini benar-benar kosong, tanpa siapa pun.)

column1: (Taking advantage of the giant dragon gradually falling into attack range, the Dolls on standby around immediately swarmed up, concentrating their attacks on the weak points where the outer defensive hard shell was destroyed by the energy beam.)
column2: (Memanfaatkan naga raksasa yang perlahan turun ke jangkauan serang, para Doll yang bersiaga di sekitarnya langsung menyerbu, memusatkan serangan pada titik lemah tempat cangkang keras pertahanan luarnya dihancurkan sinar energi.)
